0.long_answer: Cerebellar degeneration is marked by the progressive loss of GABA-releasing neurons known as Purkinje cells. These cells are the sole output neurons of the cerebellar cortex and play a crucial role in inhibitory modulation by releasing GABA. Their degeneration disrupts the balance of excitation and inhibition within the cerebellum, leading to motor control issues such as ataxia and tremor.
